column1: # external-origins.tsv -- distributed files whose ORIGIN is not in this store.
# Why this exists: some files Claude Code loads are versioned in an application
# repo, not here. Copying such a file into skills/ would make a THIRD copy and
# have check-distributed.sh compare store-vs-live -- leaving the real origin
# free to drift unnoticed, which is the whole failure this tooling exists to
# catch. Listing it here points the comparison at the origin instead.
# An unreachable source reports MISSING SOURCE and fails --strict. It never
# NOTE (2026-09-13): the aether-cross-check origin above points into the
# feat/visible-communication-u1 WORKTREE, because that is the only place the
# file exists today (commit 86b7c1b, Task 7). When that branch merges and the
# worktree is removed, this path dies and the check will report MISSING SOURCE
# rather than deleting the row. The loud failure is deliberate: a silently
# dropped row is how the 2026-09-09 stale-hook incident happened.
